Audio_numeric_metadata_check.name: Audio_numeric_metadata_check
Audio_numeric_metadata_check.value: (bitrate IS NULL OR bitrate >= 0) AND (sampleRate IS NULL OR sampleRate >= 0) AND (channels IS NULL OR channels >= 0) AND (track IS NULL OR track >= 0) AND (disc IS NULL OR disc >= 0) AND (bpm IS NULL OR bpm >= 0)

File3D_geometry_counts_check.name: File3D_geometry_counts_check
File3D_geometry_counts_check.value: (vertices IS NULL OR vertices >= 0) AND (faces IS NULL OR faces >= 0) AND (triangles IS NULL OR triangles >= 0) AND (materials IS NULL OR materials >= 0) AND (textures IS NULL OR textures >= 0) AND (animations IS NULL OR animations >= 0) AND (bones IS NULL OR bones >= 0) AND (scenes IS NULL OR scenes >= 0) AND (cameras IS NULL OR cameras >= 0) AND (lights IS NULL OR lights >= 0)

FileStats_rating_check.name: FileStats_rating_check
FileStats_rating_check.value: rating IS NULL OR rating BETWEEN 0 AND 5

File_processing_status_check.name: File_processing_status_check
File_processing_status_check.value: processingStatus IS NULL OR processingStatus IN ('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed')

Folder_color_format_check.name: Folder_color_format_check
Folder_color_format_check.value: color IS NULL OR (color LIKE '#%' AND length(color) = 7)

Image_dimensions_check.name: Image_dimensions_check
Image_dimensions_check.value: width > 0 AND width <= 32768 AND height > 0 AND height <= 32768

JsonFile_shape_check.name: JsonFile_shape_check
JsonFile_shape_check.value: (fileSize IS NULL OR fileSize >= 0) AND (keyCount IS NULL OR keyCount >= 0) AND (depth IS NULL OR depth >= 0)

QueueJob_attempts_check.name: QueueJob_attempts_check
QueueJob_attempts_check.value: attempts >= 0 AND maxAttempts > 0 AND attempts <= maxAttempts

UploadedImage_dimensions_check.name: UploadedImage_dimensions_check
UploadedImage_dimensions_check.value: (width IS NULL OR width > 0) AND (height IS NULL OR height > 0)
